REGULATIONS.name: GDPR
REGULATIONS.desc: General Data Protection Regulation — lawful processing, consent, data-subject rights

controls.name: Lawful basis recorded for each processing purpose
Consent captured, withdrawable, and honored on withdrawal
Data-subject access requests fulfilled within the deadline
Erasure executed on lawful request or retention expiry
Personal data encrypted at rest and in transit

REGULATIONS.name: CCPA
REGULATIONS.desc: California Consumer Privacy Act — notice, opt-out of sale, deletion rights

controls.name: Notice at collection published
Deletion requests honored
Opt-out of sale / sharing enforced

REGULATIONS.name: DPDP
REGULATIONS.desc: Digital Personal Data Protection Act (India) — consent, data-principal rights

controls.name: Consent obtained for a specified, lawful purpose
Data-principal rights (access, correction, erasure) actionable
Data breaches notified to the authority

REGULATIONS.name: HIPAA
REGULATIONS.desc: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act — PHI safeguards

controls.name: Access to PHI controlled and audited
PHI encrypted in transit and at rest
Audit controls record PHI access

REGULATIONS.name: PCI-DSS
REGULATIONS.desc: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard — cardholder data protection

controls.name: Cardholder data rendered unreadable wherever stored
Strong cryptography on transmission over open networks
Audit trails for all access to cardholder data
Payment gateway credentials sealed, not logged

REGULATIONS.name: SOC 2
REGULATIONS.desc: System and Organization Controls — trust services criteria

controls.name: Logical and physical access controls
System monitoring and anomaly detection
Change management with approvals
Access control policy enforced
Privacy and protection of PII
Monitoring and logging of activities

REGULATIONS.name: NIST CSF
REGULATIONS.desc: NIST Cybersecurity Framework — identify, protect, detect, respond, recover

controls.name: Identity management and access control
Data security at rest and in transit
Adverse event detection

REGULATIONS.name: FedRAMP
REGULATIONS.desc: Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program — cloud service baseline

controls.name: Access control and separation of duties
Audit logging, protection and review
System and communications protection

REGULATIONS.name: SEBI
REGULATIONS.desc: Securities and Exchange Board of India — market intermediary obligations

controls.name: KYC completed before granting credit or market access
Transaction audit trail retained and immutable

REGULATIONS.name: RBI
REGULATIONS.desc: Reserve Bank of India — payment data storage and tokenization directives

controls.name: Card data tokenized; raw PAN not stored
Payment data localisation and retention limits

REGULATIONS.name: TRAI
REGULATIONS.desc: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India — commercial communication consent

controls.name: Marketing communication sent only with registered consent
Preference registry honored for marketing channels
